coverage_explanation: This revised suite removes all cross-history PWM equality assertions: hysteresis is permitted. It tests the explicitly required transient nature of the buzzer notification by checking silence late in multiple stable-temperature plateaus, including returns to earlier inputs. It does not establish temperature-dependent fan operation, four distinct ordered duties, display correctness, or positive high-speed-entry notification. Temperature thresholds, hysteresis boundaries, PWM values, display encoding and beep timing are unspecified; the supported checks cannot condition assertions on the observed gear. Constant PWM with a silent buzzer can therefore pass this deliberately limited suite. The reference's concrete parameter choices are illustrative, not candidate acceptance criteria.
assumptions: Use the authoritative wiring: LM35 A1, fan PWM D5, TM1637 CLK D4 and DIO D2, and buzzer D6.
Rely on the disclosed bench defaults of raw ADC readings 0..1023 with a 5 V reference. LM35 conversion is 10 mV per degree Celsius.
No LED or button defaults are needed.
Thresholds, hysteresis policy, duty values, gear display representation, sampling period and exact short-beep duration are missing. No particular values for these are required by the checks.
Interpret a short entry notification as having ended after seven seconds at an unchanged input. This is a generous practical settling allowance, not a claimed exact timing requirement.
The reference uses thresholds 25/30/35 degrees Celsius, duties 0/85/170/255, numeric gears 0..3, 100 ms sampling and a 150 ms notification as permitted implementation choices.
